# Big Beautiful Flop

> Making presidential statements presidential again.

An independent satirical project. Original statements are sourced and attributed. All presidential and regional adaptations are fictional, AI-assisted editorial interpretations.

Each article quotes one public statement by Donald Trump verbatim, with its date and source, then offers satirical adaptations: a "presidential" version and regional versions (French-speaking Switzerland, France), each with an English adaptation. Only the original statement is a quotation; every adaptation is fictional and must never be attributed to Donald Trump.

## Articles

- [The very stable genius](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/very-stable-genius/): Asked about his mental fitness, the President answered with his CV, a jab at Hillary Clinton and a new job title. We asked a real president, and a few cantons, to try again.
- [Covfefe](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/covfefe/): Six words, one of which does not exist. The post stayed up for hours. A real president would have issued a correction; Fribourg and the Nord have other explanations.
- [Nobody knew health care could be so complicated](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/nobody-knew-health-care/): A discovery announced to the nation’s governors, many of whom had known for some time. Neuchâtel and Lyon were not surprised either.
